title: `Core\Path::fromCwd` removes `tainted` from a path typed on the command line, and nothing else
scope:
Which qualifier `Core\Path::fromCwd`'s answer carries, and the one exception that makes it a
launderer for the file-path sink. The member's join, its refusal during a request and every
`fs` grant are unchanged.
dependsOnText:
[0241](0241.md) (a relative path built at run time throws, and `fromCwd` is the one way
to the working directory), [0024](0024.md) (laundering is sink-named), [0133](0133.md) (which
launderers answer a carrier).
validatedBy:
the Stage 4 checks of goal `path-literals-follow-up`: `nvs-stdlib`'s
`from_cwd_returns_a_string_without_tainted`, and the two `.nvst` cases named under *Verification*.
